_about: The camp save (scripts/camp/camp_save.gd): JSON with a version number, a backup of the previous save and migrations. new_camp is the whole-year layout every save starts from; a save missing any key gets it from here when loaded. Profiles are keyed by profile ID, never a connection ID. couch marks a character made on the host's couch that no PC has claimed yet; link_code lets its own PC claim it once. last_seen (Unix seconds) picks who drops in on the couch. looks are the camper models handed to new profiles, least-used first.
